how: Voiced locally in a Claude session, no Actions run, 0 credits: kokoro-onnx with the hash-pinned Kokoro v1.0 assets (kokoro-v1.0.fp16.onnx, voices-v1.0.bin bca610b8..., verify_public_voice_asset.ASSETS) through pilot_render.py voice, each line one segment in its speaker's characters.json voice at speed 1.0. A line is its sentences from the first sentence's start to the last sentence's end in timeline.json (the method of evidence/long/20261026/noah-scoffer-voice.json); a voice's pace is its words over its seconds; words are plan_check.words (split on spaces).
calibration: Adam's and Eve's three lines of noah-scoffer-voice.json in the same run: 3.798 (the same to the third decimal) and 3.560 (3.566 there), so the method and the model are the same.
lines_chosen: Cain (am_eric, arc-02 long): his KJV line of the plan (Genesis 4:13-14), one other KJV-based line and six short dramatic lines of the kind a Genesis 4 Short would give him, 11-17 words each, the talking-line range.

each.line: My punishment is greater than I can bear. Behold, thou hast driven me out this day
I know not: Am I my brother's keeper? He keeps the sheep, not me.
Every one that findeth me shall slay me. Where can I hide from thy face?
Abel, come out with me into the field. There is something I must show you.
Why does his smoke rise and mine fall back? I gave the work of my own hands.
I tilled this ground with my own hands, and now it will not answer me.
A fugitive and a vagabond. Is that all I am now, a man with no ground?
Do not look at me like that. I brought an offering too, the same as he did.
This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman,
I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.
The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
He says you will not die. He says your eyes will be opened, and you will see.
God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
It was the serpent. He twisted every word. The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.

used_by: migration/production/bible/voice_pace.py VOICE_PACE cain 3.340, VOICE_SLOWEST cain 2.732 (min(3.340 x 2.25/2.75 = 2.733, slowest line 2.759)).
reading: Cain (am_eric) speaks between the narrator (2.874) and Eve (3.566-3.732); his 16-word plan line measures about 4.8 s, inside one talking hold.
